en.promotional_text: Recruit units, build your lineup and explore strategic auto battles. Discover synergies, refine your formation and make every preparation count.
en.description:
GLory Auto Chess is a strategy game built around team composition and automatic battles.

BUILD YOUR LINEUP
Recruit units, arrange their positions and improve your team. Explore combinations of races, synergies, treasures and mercenaries.

PREPARE, THEN BATTLE
Make your choices during preparation and watch your lineup fight. Adapt your strategy for the challenges ahead.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Explore custom rooms, multiplayer matches and spectating. Optional text chat, voice messages and real-time voice let you communicate; microphone access is not required to play.

GET STARTED EASILY
Start as a guest without registering an email account. Includes a tutorial and Chinese and English interfaces.

An internet connection is required.
Support: https://glorytd-api.duckdns.org/beta/support.html
Privacy: https://glorytd-api.duckdns.org/beta/privacy-en.html
